title: Pocket Goes to Seattle
refrain: "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
palette: evergreen, rain blue, brick red, mustard yellow, latte brown
sky: soft silver-blue drizzly morning → pale gold break in the clouds → peach and rose sunset over the water → lavender dusk with twinkling lights
cover: Pocket sits on a bench in front of the Space Needle, with a little yellow umbrella tucked beside and soft rain clouds above.

pages.text: Pocket peeks out of the backpack. The Space Needle pokes up into the soft grey clouds. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a railing seen from behind, facing the Space Needle rising into low clouds. Silver-blue drizzly morning light.

pages.text: Whoosh! At Pike Place Market, a shiny silver fish flies through the air. The fishmonger catches it. Pocket's ears wiggle.
pages.beat: Pocket on a market rail at left. A silver fish arcs between two men in green aprons over an ice-filled stall. Drizzly light.

pages.text: Buckets and buckets of flowers! Pink, yellow, and red. Pocket sniffs and sniffs. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a market shelf beside many buckets of pink, yellow and red flowers, low in frame. Soft silver-blue light, plain wall above.

pages.text: Pocket spots a coffee cup on a bench. Steam curls up from the lid, up and up, into the drizzle.
pages.beat: Pocket sits on a wooden bench beside one brown paper coffee cup with a curl of steam. Grey-blue drizzly light.

pages.text: Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. Umbrellas bloom along the street, red, yellow, and green. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a lamppost ledge above a street of five bobbing umbrellas, red, yellow and green. Light turning pale gold.

pages.text: A big green ferry glides across Puget Sound. Pocket watches it go, slow and steady, across the shining water.
pages.beat: Pocket on a pier rail at the bottom of the frame. One green and white ferry on pale gold water. Breaking clouds.

pages.text: The rain stops. The clouds part, and there is Mount Rainier, big and quiet, with a snowy white top.
pages.beat: Pocket on a hilltop bench, small, facing a far-off snowy Mount Rainier above gentle clouds. Pale gold light, plain sky.

pages.text: Puff! Far out on the water, an orca rises, black and white and gentle. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket small on a waterfront railing. One distant orca with a little spout on calm water. Peach and rose sunset.

pages.text: Whirr, whirr. Pocket rides the monorail high over the street. Rooftops glow pink and gold below.
pages.beat: Pocket on a window seat inside a monorail car, looking out at rooftops. Rose and peach sunset glow.

pages.text: The lights come on, one by one. The Space Needle twinkles. "Hello, Seattle," says Pocket. Look and look.
pages.beat: Pocket on a hotel windowsill seen from behind, facing the lit Space Needle and tiny city lights. Lavender dusk.

pages.text: The lights twinkle. Pocket yawns a big, slow yawn. One ear droops. Then the other.
pages.beat: Pocket on the windowsill, small and sleepy, ears drooping. Soft twinkling lights through pale lavender dusk.

pages.text: Pocket is tucked up on the windowsill bed, fast asleep. Goodnight, Pocket. Goodnight, Seattle.
pages.beat: Pocket asleep on a cream cushion bed on the windowsill. Window shows twinkling city lights and the Space Needle in lavender dusk.

synopsis: Pocket arrives in Seattle on a soft, drizzly morning and sees the Space Needle poking up into the clouds. Perched on a market rail, Pocket watches fish fly at Pike Place Market, sniffs buckets of flowers, and spots a coffee cup steaming beside a bench. Umbrellas bloom like flowers, a green ferry glides across Puget Sound, and Mount Rainier shows its snowy top when the rain stops. A friendly orca puffs far out on the water. Pocket rides the monorail, then falls asleep on the hotel windowsill bed with the city lights twinkling outside.
setting: Seattle: the Space Needle, Pike Place Market with fish and flowers, ferries on Puget Sound, rain and umbrellas, a coffee cup, Mount Rainier in the distance, orcas, a monorail
